title.narrative: Empowering Young Indonesian Women and Men to Find Their Voice and Speak

description.narrative: The project's expected effect(s) on society is to create conflict prevention initiatives through learning and linking with vulnerable communities and government agencies. The expected effects for the target groups are: 1) Comprehensive updated training modules and tools produced and enriched with context mapping on human rights and peacebuilding issues, including conflict prevention initiatives. 2) Equip 20 young human rights defenders to take the lead in promoting human rights, peacebuilding and conflict prevention initiatives, including intiating community-based advocacy for marginalised and vulnerable groups. 3) Enhance capacity of 20 young human rights defenders to facilitate marginalised and vulnerable communities in analysing their priority issues on human rights and peace and promoting community-led strategies to access basic rights and promote prevention. 4) Empower 20 young human rights defenders by working with communities, understanding other contexts, as well as by enancing their networks and building solidarity, 5) Empower at least 1,000 people from 20 communities to stories and experiences of young human rights defenders and marginalised and vulnerable groups, leading to a better understanding and awareness of human rights, peacebuilding and conflict prevention. 6) Strengthen engagement with government to acknowledge community-based initiatives by marginalised and vulnerable groups. 7) Provide greater access by members of marginalised and vulnerable groups to basic needs and the fullfilment of their human rights (outcome).
